description: This file defines a static helper class 'TokenCredentialHelper' that provides methods to create Azure service clients (Table and Queue) with appropriate credentials, and to obtain tokens for managed identities. It handles different credential scenarios including environment variables and emulator configurations.

classes.name: TokenCredentialHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods to create Azure service clients with appropriate credentials and to retrieve tokens for managed identities.

methods.name: CreateTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates a TableServiceClient for the given Azure Table URI, using emulator credentials if URI is loopback.

methods.name: CreateQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Creates a QueueServiceClient for the given Azure Queue URI, using emulator credentials if URI is loopback.

methods.name: GetTokenCredential
methods.description: Returns a TokenCredential object based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: GetManagedIdentityToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token for a user-assigned Managed Identity given its client ID and audience.
